entities.name: Guty Cárdenas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Guty Cárdenas was a Mexican composer, singer and guitarist, noted as a representative of the cancion yucateca style of music. His well-known works include "Nunca", with lyrics by Ricardo López Méndez. He spent several years in the US, recording with Columbia Records.
